sents.d: A defined process prevents service quality from dropping as orders grow.
As order volume increases, informally answering customer messages as they come in becomes unsustainable, and response times tend to slip exactly when reputation matters most.

scenes.heading: Use a help desk and templates

sents.d: A simple help desk tool, even a basic one, centralizes messages across channels (email, social, live chat) so nothing gets lost, and template responses for common questions (shipping status, return policy, sizing) speed up response time without sounding robotic if lightly personalized.

Setting and communicating a clear response-time standard (e.g., replies within 24 hours) manages customer expectations even during busier periods, and tracking common complaint types over time can reveal product or process issues worth fixing at the source.

take: Centralize support and promise a clear response time.
